title: stelis fonsflorum
intro: Stelis fonsflorum, commonly known as Stelis, is a flowering plant species in the orchid family, characterized by its unique and fragrant flowers. The health benefits of Stelis include its potential to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Stelis include its use as a natural remedy for various health issues, such as fever reduction, and its potential to support respiratory health. The bioactive constituents of Stelis include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
